findings.name: Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set
findings.reason: No Content-Security-Policy on any page; raises the impact of any script injection.

findings.name: Cross-Domain Misconfiguration
findings.reason: No Access-Control-Allow-Credentials, and sign-in is a bearer token another site cannot read, so only public data is readable cross-origin. Revisit if cookie sign-in is added.
